0022600222.text: The Lakers, who are 10-2 and first in the Pacific and the West, arrive on a six-game winning streak and an 8-2 record over their last ten games, while the Bucks are 1-9, 15th in the East, and have lost six straight. Austin Reaves (illness) and Quentin Grimes (finger) are both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions for Los Angeles, with Reaves averaging 25.3 points and Grimes 8.0 points this season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their last meeting was a 105-101 Lakers loss in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026, with no games between them yet this season.
